results.overview: After the loss of her mother, Margo's life takes an unexpected turn when her estranged older sister reappears in her life. As grief and unresolved family tensions weigh heavily on her, Margo attempts her hardest rock climb yet.

results.title: The Sinks
results.overview: A small band from Tucson - comprised of four best friends - plays their final show at the end of college.

results.title: Evil in the House
results.overview: Beth cares for a reclusive elderly man in a secluded house. As eerie whispers and shadows grow more intense.  Soon, Beth realizes she may never escape its sinister grip.

results.title: Faithful Intentions
results.overview: She thought she won a dream weekend. The intruders think she's someone else—and the lie keeping her alive could expose the affair that started it all.

results.title: Pride Weekend
results.overview: Five friends visit LA for Pride Weekend and encounter masked stalkers who turn a prank into a deadly killing spree. Trapped in a city of shadows, they must fight to survive as trust erodes and danger lurks at every turn.

results.title: Warrior God of Exorcism
results.overview: The film centers on the path to immortality of Li Xuan, the former life of Tieguai Li, the leader of the Eight Immortals. It tells the fantastical story of how, during his demon-subduing endeavors, his physical body was stolen, he fell in love with the fox demon Chu Yu , but was persecuted by the Nine Nether God .

results.title: Glaciers - Melting Giants
results.overview: Climate change is accelerating the melting of glaciers around the world. A study conducted across all continents sounds the alarm about the urgent need to preserve them.

results.title: Terbang
results.overview: The story of the country's legendary rallyer, Karamjit Singh (shortled "Flying Sikh"). His plot focuses on his rise, great sacrifices, and the never-fafeated fighting spirit to make Malaysia proud in the international motorsports scene.

results.title: Lightworkers
results.overview: Thirty-seven diverse men and women confront the problem of saving their democracy from fascism.

results.title: The Signature
results.overview: A mute Turkish wife imagines her future during a viewing of a cold and uninviting New York apartment.

results.title: Mateo
results.overview: After losing his mother, young Mateo has spent his entire life wondering about the father he barely remembers. As he draws closer to the answers he sought, Mateo discovers that the journey is not just about finding his father, but about understanding the true meaning of family.

results.title: "Sugar"
results.overview: A sidelined career criminal spirals into a fit of jealousy and rage when the new guy shows up.

results.title: The Great Plague: The Village That Saved Britain
results.original_title: The Great Plague: The Village That Saved Britain
results.overview: The story of Eyam, a small, isolated village in the Peak District, whose residents endured one of the worst outbreaks of bubonic plague ever seen. In the mid 1660s, plague reached the remote Derbyshire village, and as the disease tore through the community, young vicar William Mompesson made an extraordinary decision - to seal the village off entirely. Historian Ruth Goodman tells the story of some of the villagers who lived and died through 14 months of horror.

results.title: IceGuys: The Movie
results.overview: When Iceland's hottest boyband ICEGUYS accidentally enters an international reality show competition, they must out-sing, out-dance and out-last other rival boy bands to win a coveted opening slot on an upcoming world tour.

results.title: Jockey
results.overview: The film Jackie is based on the ancient goat fighting tradition of Madurai. In a village in Madurai, Ramar and Karthi enter their goats into a goat fight competition. Ramars goat wins the competition. Envious, Karthi tries to take revenge on Ramar and his goat, causing various troubles for Ramar. Ramar thwarts these attempts and protects his goat.

results.title: Investigator
results.overview: Amidst the foggy evergreen forests of Washington State's Olympic Peninsula, private investigator Leigh Hearon explores the criminal underbelly of a small town that has been transformed by the loss of manufacturing jobs and the invasion of meth and opiates. Recently employed by a local public defender on a case of attempted matricide, INVESTIGATOR delves into Hearon's personal motivations and her place in the criminal justice system as she reaches the latter part of her thirty-year career.

results.title: Vita mia
results.overview: Didi, a Hungarian noblewoman who survived war and communism, has lived in Salento for years, cared for by Vita, a young woman from Puglia. She spends her final days amidst memories, guilt, and friendship, searching for peace.

results.title: Txakun txakür
results.overview: Nobody remembers their first school playtime. That day when the adults had gone. That day, I was in the playground. For eight years I filmed the same group of childen, asking myself: how do we grow under the gaze of others? As the years pass, the playtime games gave way to role playing; the "You're not my friend any more" gave way to the "you're not playing". One day I arrived late. Behind the cries, I could see them hitting Élise. How didn't I see it coming?
